title: Control Mechanisms
subtitle: Test your grasp of Control Mechanisms — Density Suppression, Overlays, NPCs, the Three Strings, Amnesia Vortex, Resets, and the failing parasitic grid.

reflection.title: Reflection

Sit with what you missed, then return to the Control Mechanisms deep-dive, infographics, and video transmissions. As the G.A.A. turns off Overlays, uninstall Religion, Finance, and Perceived Knowledge — and take the flat-earth first step — so the EMF flash finds you awake rather than collapsed.
